name: Communication Protocols on PLCs
description: Set of rules that allow industrial devices to communicate with one another
author: Techdoc, 2026

words.definition: A serial communication protocol used in industrial automation systems to transmit data between electronic devices such as controllers, sensors, and actuators.
words.example_en: The PLC reads temperature data from the sensor over Modbus during the system test.
words.example_sk: PLC počas testu systému číta údaje o teplote zo snímača cez Modbus.

words.definition: A person or company that receives professional services from an engineer, contractor, or consulting firm.
words.example_en: The engineering team presented the bridge design to the client for approval.
words.example_sk: Inžiniersky tím predstavil klientovi návrh mosta na schválenie.

words.definition: A computer or system that provides data, services, or resources to other computers over a network.
words.example_en: The engineering team restarted the server to restore access to the control system.
words.example_sk: Inžiniersky tím reštartoval server, aby obnovil prístup k riadiacemu systému.

words.definition: A method of serial data exchange used in engineering systems to enable devices such as drives, controllers, and automation components to communicate.
words.example_en: The engineer configured USS communication between the frequency converter and the PLC to monitor motor speed and send control commands.
words.example_sk: Inžinier nakonfiguroval komunikáciu USS medzi frekvenčným meničom a PLC na monitorovanie rýchlosti motora a odosielanie riadiacich príkazov.

words.definition: A method of communication in which data is sent directly between two specific devices or locations.
words.example_en: The control system uses point-to-point communication to transfer sensor data directly from the field device to the PLC.
words.example_sk: Riadiaci systém používa komunikáciu bod-bod na priamy prenos údajov zo senzora do PLC.

words.definition: Systems or points of connection that allow devices, machines, or software to exchange information.
words.example_en: Mechatronic components, such as motors and drives, often use various communication interfaces to interact with control systems and other devices
words.example_sk: Mechatronické komponenty, ako sú motory a pohony, často používajú rôzne komunikačné rozhrania na interakciu s riadiacimi systémami a inými zariadeniami.

words.definition: A software application that allows a computer to access and interact with a command-line interface like a physical terminal.
words.example_en: The engineer opened a terminal emulator to configure the embedded system through the serial port.
words.example_sk: Inžinier otvoril emulátor terminálu, aby nakonfiguroval zabudovaný systém cez sériový port.

words.definition: The exchange of data between devices over a network using the Transmission Control Protocol, which ensures reliable and ordered delivery of packets.
words.example_en: The control system uses TCP communication to send reliable data between the PLC and the monitoring server.
words.example_sk: Riadiaci systém používa komunikáciu TCP na spoľahlivý prenos dát medzi PLC a monitorovacím serverom.

words.definition: A serial communication protocol used in industrial engineering to exchange data between control devices such as PLCs, sensors, and meters.
words.example_en: Modbus RTU is used to connect PLCs to temperature sensors on a production line.
words.example_sk: Modbus RTU sa používa na prepojenie PLC s teplotnými senzormi na výrobnej linke.

words.definition: An industrial communication protocol that uses TCP/IP to transmit Modbus messages over Ethernet networks between devices such as controllers, sensors, and supervisory systems.
words.example_en: The engineer configured the PLC to exchange data with the SCADA system via Modbus TCP over the factory Ethernet network.
words.example_sk: Inžinier nakonfiguroval PLC tak, aby vymieňal údaje so systémom SCADA cez Modbus TCP v podnikovej ethernetovej sieti.

words.definition: Instruments, devices, or software used to identify faults, measure performance, or assess the condition of systems and equipment.
words.example_en: The engineering team used diagnostic tools to detect the fault in the control system.
words.example_sk: Inžiniersky tím použil diagnostické nástroje na odhalenie poruchy v riadiacom systéme.

words.definition: An industrial communication protocol used to connect automation devices such as sensors, actuators, and controllers in a control system.
words.example_en: The engineers used DeviceNet to link the sensors and motor controllers on the production line.
words.example_sk: Inžinieri použili DeviceNet na prepojenie snímačov a riadiacich jednotiek motorov na výrobnej linke.

words.definition: An industrial fieldbus communication standard used to connect controllers, sensors, actuators, and other automation devices in engineering systems.
words.example_en: The engineer configured the Profibus network to link the PLC with the motor drives and sensors on the production line.
words.example_sk: Inžinier nakonfiguroval sieť Profibus na prepojenie PLC s motorovými pohonmi a senzormi na výrobnej linke.

words.definition: A high-speed industrial Ethernet communication protocol used for real-time control and automation systems.
words.example_en: The engineers selected EtherCAT to ensure fast and reliable communication between the PLC and the servo drives.
words.example_sk: Inžinieri vybrali EtherCAT, aby zabezpečili rýchlu a spoľahlivú komunikáciu medzi PLC a servopohonmi.

words.definition: A neural network architecture used to guide and constrain the output of a generative model by adding control signals such as edges, poses, or depth maps.
words.example_en: The engineering team used ControlNet to exchange real-time control data between PLCs and remote I/O modules.
words.example_sk: Inžiniersky tím použil ControlNet na generovanie návrhov prototypov z hĺbkových máp a obrysových náčrtov.

words.definition: A communication protocol used in industrial engineering to transmit digital data between field instruments and control systems over analog wiring.
words.example_en: The engineer configured the pressure transmitter through the HART protocol without interrupting the 4–20 mA signal.
words.example_sk: Inžinier nakonfiguroval tlakový prevodník cez protokol HART bez prerušenia signálu 4–20 mA.

words.definition: A digital communication system that connects sensors, actuators, and controllers in industrial automation.
words.example_en: The factory uses a fieldbus to transmit data between machines and the central control system.
words.example_sk: Továreň používa zbernicu v priemyselnej sieti na prenos údajov medzi strojmi a centrálnym riadiacim systémom.

words.definition: A communication protocol and device profile standard used in industrial automation systems, based on the CAN bus.
words.example_en: The factory integrated CANopen to connect sensors, drives, and controllers on the production line.
words.example_sk: Továreň integrovala CANopen na prepojenie senzorov, pohonov a riadiacich jednotiek na výrobnej linke.

words.definition: A simple industrial networking system used to connect sensors and actuators to control systems.
words.example_en: The factory uses AS-Interface to connect sensors and actuators on the production line.
words.example_sk: Továreň používa rozhranie AS-Interface na pripojenie snímačov a akčných členov na výrobnej linke.

words.definition: A system of connected physical devices that collect and exchange data over the internet.
words.example_en: Many factories use IoT sensors to monitor machine performance and improve production efficiency.
words.example_sk: Mnohé továrne používajú senzory internetu vecí na monitorovanie výkonu strojov a zlepšenie efektívnosti výroby.

words.definition: A wireless technology standard used for exchanging data over short distances between devices.
words.example_en: The engineer used Bluetooth to connect the sensor module to the control unit during testing.
words.example_sk: Inžinier použil Bluetooth na pripojenie modulu senzora k riadiacej jednotke počas testovania.

words.definition: A standard for communication and data exchange between industrial devices, control systems, and software applications.
words.example_en: The SCADA system uses OPC to exchange real-time data with the PLCs on the production line.
words.example_sk: Systém SCADA používa OPC na výmenu dát v reálnom čase s PLC na výrobnej linke.

words.definition: A wireless communication standard used for low-power, short-range networking between devices, especially in automation and monitoring systems.
words.example_en: The engineers used Zigbee sensors to monitor temperature and vibration across the production line.
words.example_sk: Inžinieri použili senzory Zigbee na monitorovanie teploty a vibrácií na celej výrobnej linke.

words.definition: Operating or happening immediately as data is received or events occur, without noticeable delay.
words.example_en: The control system provides real-time monitoring of temperature and pressure in the reactor.
words.example_sk: Riadiaci systém poskytuje monitorovanie teploty a tlaku v reálnom čase v reaktore.

words.definition: The use of control systems, computers, and machines to operate industrial processes with minimal human intervention.
words.example_en: Industrial automation improves efficiency and reduces errors on modern manufacturing lines.
words.example_sk: Priemyselná automatizácia zvyšuje efektivitu a znižuje chyby na moderných výrobných linkách.

words.definition: A set of rules that defines how data is transmitted and received between devices in a network.
words.example_en: The engineer configured the network protocol to ensure reliable communication between the control system and the sensors.
words.example_sk: Inžinier nakonfiguroval sieťový protokol, aby zabezpečil spoľahlivú komunikáciu medzi riadiacim systémom a senzormi.

words.definition: An electricity network that uses digital technology to monitor, control, and optimize the production and distribution of power.
words.example_en: Engineers designed the smart grid to balance electricity demand and integrate renewable energy sources more efficiently.
words.example_sk: Inžinieri navrhli inteligentnú elektrickú sieť tak, aby vyrovnávala dopyt po elektrine a efektívnejšie integrovala obnoviteľné zdroje energie.

words.definition: A communication standard whose specifications are publicly available so different systems and devices can use it and work together.
words.example_en: The engineering team selected an open protocol to ensure that sensors from different manufacturers could communicate with the control system.
words.example_sk: Inžiniersky tím vybral otvorený protokol, aby senzory od rôznych výrobcov mohli komunikovať s riadiacim systémom.

words.definition: The use of systems, devices, and processes to monitor and regulate machines and production operations in industry.
words.example_en: Industrial control helps engineers automate production and maintain safe operating conditions.
words.example_sk: Systémy priemyselného riadenia pomáhajú inžinierom automatizovať výrobnú linku a udržiavať bezpečné prevádzkové podmienky.

words.definition: A communication protocol in which data is transmitted without a shared clock signal, often using start and stop bits or event-based timing.
words.example_en: The embedded system uses an asynchronous protocol to exchange sensor data with the controller over a serial interface.
words.example_sk: Zabudovaný systém používa asynchrónny protokol na výmenu údajov zo snímača s riadiacou jednotkou cez sériové rozhranie.

words.definition: A basic or lower stage, layer, or degree in a system, process, or structure.
words.example_en: The sensor detects low level changes in voltage in the control circuit.
words.example_sk: Senzor deteguje zmeny napätia na nízkej úrovni v riadiacom obvode.

words.definition: A connection or circuit that links a sensor to a control system, processor, or other electronic device.
words.example_en: The engineer checked the sensor interface to ensure accurate data transfer from the temperature probe to the controller.
words.example_sk: Inžinier skontroloval rozhranie snímača, aby zabezpečil presný prenos údajov z teplotnej sondy do riadiacej jednotky.

words.definition: A device that converts energy into mechanical motion or force to control a mechanism or system.
words.example_en: The actuator opens the valve automatically when the control system detects high pressure.
words.example_sk: Pohon automaticky otvorí ventil, keď riadiaci systém zistí vysoký tlak.

words.definition: The lowest layer of a network model that transmits raw bits over a physical medium such as cables, radio waves, or optical fiber.
words.example_en: In network engineering, the physical layer defines how signals are transmitted through copper cables and fiber optics.
words.example_sk: V sieťovom inžinierstve fyzická vrstva určuje, ako sa signály prenášajú cez medené káble a optické vlákna.

words.definition: Happening at the same time or operating in step with another process or system.
words.example_en: The synchronous motor rotates at a speed that matches the frequency of the power supply.
words.example_sk: Synchrónny motor sa otáča rýchlosťou, ktorá zodpovedá frekvencii napájania.

words.definition: An electrical circuit path in which electric current flows in a closed loop.
words.example_en: The engineer tested the current loop to verify stable signal transmission between the sensor and the control unit.
words.example_sk: Inžinier testoval prúdovú slučku, aby overil stabilný prenos signálu medzi senzorom a riadiacou jednotkou.

words.definition: The process of making something conform to an agreed set of rules, specifications, or norms.
words.example_en: Standardization of bolt sizes helps engineers assemble machines more efficiently.
words.example_sk: Štandardizácia veľkostí skrutiek pomáha inžinierom zostavovať stroje efektívnejšie.

words.definition: A shared communication system that transfers data or power between components in a machine or electronic system.
words.example_en: The engineer connected the sensors to the main bus on the control board.
words.example_sk: Inžinier pripojil senzory k hlavnej zbernici na riadiacej doske.

words.definition: Digital industrial computers used to control machines and processes in automation systems.
words.example_en: Programmable logic controllers are used in the factory to automate conveyor belts, sensors, and robotic arms.
words.example_sk: Programovateľné logické automaty sa používajú vo výrobe na automatizáciu dopravníkových pásov, senzorov a robotických ramien.

words.definition: Having source code that is made publicly available so that anyone can view, modify, and distribute it.
words.example_en: The engineering team used open-source software to control the prototype testing system.
words.example_sk: Inžiniersky tím použil open-source softvér na riadenie systému testovania prototypu.

words.definition: The monitoring and adjustment of industrial or engineering processes to keep them operating safely, efficiently, and within desired limits.
words.example_en: Process control systems help engineers maintain stable temperature and pressure in the chemical plant.
words.example_sk: Systémy riadenia procesu pomáhajú inžinierom udržiavať stabilnú teplotu a tlak v chemickom závode.

words.definition: The transmission and reception of information using radio frequency electromagnetic waves.
words.example_en: The engineering team tested the RF communications system to ensure reliable data transfer between the control unit and the remote sensor.
words.example_sk: Inžiniersky tím testoval systém rádiovej frekvenčnej komunikácie, aby zabezpečil spoľahlivý prenos údajov medzi riadiacou jednotkou a vzdialeným senzorom.

words.definition: The transmission of information over a distance by electronic means, such as phone, radio, or the internet.
words.example_en: Modern telecommunication systems allow engineers to monitor industrial equipment remotely.
words.example_sk: Moderné telekomunikačné systémy umožňujú inžinierom monitorovať priemyselné zariadenia na diaľku.

words.definition: In a way that follows a fixed order, one step after another.
words.example_en: The control system processes sensor data sequentially to avoid errors in the engineering test.
words.example_sk: Riadiaci systém spracúva údaje zo senzorov sekvenčne, aby sa predišlo chybám pri inžinierskom teste.

words.definition: A method of data transfer in which multiple bits are sent at the same time through separate channels or wires.
words.example_en: In the control system, parallel communication allows several signals to be transmitted simultaneously between modules.
words.example_sk: V riadiacom systéme paralelná komunikácia umožňuje prenášať viacero signálov súčasne medzi modulmi.
